model_boundaries: Actual independent inaccessible Markov Z dephasing at rate lambda, from specimen arrival.
All free full retained instruments commute with each relevant source Z conjugation.
Actual Hamiltonian source commutation support has size at most k, with summed per-site h_a=2||H_a|| budget.
Full classical-feedback theorem uses per-record budgets; sharper coefficient requires global decomposition.
Fixed-k optimal copy exponent is matched only for full-weight known parity at fixed contrast and GHZ-versus-mixture promises.
Universal purity is a lower-bound consequence, without a matching universal upper construction.
Zero-start slew envelope holds at each specimen's arrival, not just at initial hardware startup.
Noiseless independent protected meters and actual local interaction ports are premises for the ideal upper construction; calibrated approximate binary channels require trusted reference preparations.
Scalar or single-site calibration does not acquire independence, Markovianity, or absence of common causes.
Numerical tests evaluate selected input operators and ODEs; they do not compute general diamond norms or simulate a physical device.
